_comment: Scheduled jobs the deadman's job-watch pass checks from outside. max_age_hours: how long since the last run before it is called overdue. check: 'result+overdue' (default) also pages on a nonzero exit code; 'overdue-only' ignores the exit code (use for jobs whose code is ambiguous, e.g. smriti-morning exits 1 on 'already sent today'). disabled_ok:true means being DISABLED is expected (a cron task staged but not yet cut over) so job-watch skips it; without it, an unexpectedly-disabled task PAGES (accidental disable silently stops work). At cutover, arm the Windows task and set disabled_ok:false (or remove it) so it is watched normally. Installed to %LOCALAPPDATA%/narada/job-watch.json; edit there.
